game.title: Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare
game.blurb: Near-future first-person shooter from Sledgehammer Games (RAWG also lists Raven Software and High Moon Studios), published by Activision Blizzard, released 2014-11-03. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the campaign missions named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Induction to Aftermath
chapters.summary: The first five numbered missions: Induction, Atlas (with its shooting and grenade ranges), Traffic, Fission and Aftermath with its hoverbike drive.

chapters.title: Manhunt to Bio Lab
chapters.summary: Missions six to ten, including Manhunt, Sentinel and Bio Lab with the hovertank. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Armada to Captured
chapters.summary: The last missions numbered in the achievements: Armada, Throttle and Captured. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Finishing the Campaign
chapters.summary: Completing the campaign on any difficulty, then on Hardened and Veteran.

chapters.title: Intel
chapters.summary: Collecting over half, then all, of the intel.

chapters.title: Exo Upgrades and Combat
chapters.summary: Spending Exo upgrade points, grenade types, drones, Overdrive, boost-jump stomps and other combat feats.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 209650)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Advanced_Warfare
Fandom (callofduty.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://callofduty.fandom.com/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Advanced_Warfare
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 842). The only Steam app in the store list is 209650, "Call of Duty®: Advanced Warfare - Gold Edition" (its schema is named "Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare"), so that edition was used; RAWG keeps the Gold Edition and the "Havoc" and "Ascendance" entries separately, and no achievement names them. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs): only Controls and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 13 of 45 Steam achievements are hidden: API names LEVEL_1 to LEVEL_13, one per numbered level. Each was placed with the visible LEVEL_nA achievement of the same number, whose description names the mission ("Induction" is 1A, "Atlas" 2A and 2B, "Captured" 14A and 14), so the hidden ones sit in the mission chapters by API number, a reasoned guess. Missions 7, 9 and 11 have no visible achievement, so their names are not in the data. The mission groupings of five, five and four are our own choice. There are no multiplayer or co-op achievements on this app.
